title: Amateur dramatic society

paragraphs.text: Now listen carefully and answer questions one to five.
Hello, how can I help you?
Hi, I've just moved to the area and saw an advertisement for your drama society, so I'm calling to find out some more details.
Sure. I'm the society secretary. My name's Jane Caulfield.
Uh, thanks. Can you tell me exactly where the society is based?

Well, the address for the society is my address, which is 117 Green Road, like the color, and that's in Prestwin. But that's just the mailing address. It's not where we actually rehearse. We do that at the club House in Wynn. It's behind the playing fields. It used to be a cricket club, you see.
So is this a new interest, or do you have some acting experience? It doesn't matter if you haven't, you know. Experience isn't a requirement.
Well, that's good because I haven't got any, but I am musical, and I've got some experience of song festivals.
Oh, that's great. We're always looking for actors and singers, of course, especially male ones. Oh, by the way, do you have a car?
It's a big help if you're able to drive. Not all our members have access to transport, so it's very helpful.

paragraphs.label: I
paragraphs.text:
see. Well, I'm sure I can help out there. So when do you actually meet?

00:01:35,460

On Tuesday from six till 8 PM.

00:01:39,360

Sorry, y-you said Tuesday, not Thursday?

00:01:42,600

Yes.

00:01:43,660

Good. Thursdays are a problem for me. Uh, I do some private tutoring and can't move that.

00:01:49,880

Right.

00:01:51,340

And that's all year, no breaks?

00:01:54,360

Good point. We do close for a couple of weeks, you know, in August, so we don't get together then.

00:02:04,540

Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions six to ten. Now listen and answer questions six to ten.

00:02:26,840

And is there a joining fee?

00:02:29,260

To be a member costs just forty pounds.

00:02:32,100

paragraphs.label: A
paragraphs.text:
year?

00:02:33,020

Yes, and that covers our annual dinner.

00:02:35,300

Right.

00:02:37,080

But there's a rate for concessions, which are for people over sixty and the unemployed.

00:02:43,320

I've just retired, so that's good news. What's the discount?

00:02:47,960

It was ten percent, but now it's more. You pay just 25 pounds, which is a reduction of 15 pounds.

00:02:55,600

Every little helps after all, especially with a teenage son. Actually, I wanted to ask if there's an age limit. Could Jack come along, too? He's fifteen.

00:03:07,280

Actually, we have a special youth group, and that's open to anyone up to and including 16 years old, so he could join that.

00:03:16,060

Great. Keep him out of trouble. And, uh, what about the shows you put on? You said you were very busy. Uh, do you have plays, et cetera, every year, or how does it work?

00:03:28,460

Well, we put on at least two productions a year. Occasionally, we might do Shakespeare, but normally we choose works by modern playwrights.

00:03:37,950

Sounds quite varied and challenging. And you rehearse for the two productions when you meet up?

00:03:44,940

Certainly, but that's not all we do. We also write our own family show each winter for the December holidays, which is always a lot of fun and is actually very popular in the local community. We donate the money we make to the children's hospital here.

00:04:01,220

Well... Oh, that sounds very nice. I've been involved in charity work-

00:04:09,340

That is the end of part one. You now have one minute to check your answers to part one.
